visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long wavy hair in a green shirt sits on a grey couch, gesturing towards another man wearing a grey t-shirt and a light cap. The man in green has an expressive, energetic facial expression, while the man in the cap appears slightly hesitant. On the coffee table in the foreground, there is a glass of bubbling water with fruit slices and a small bottle of pink liquid. (2) A sharp transition to a close-up shot of a clear glass filled with carbonated water and chunks of fresh peach. Small bubbles rise to the surface. Next to it, a small purple and pink box and a matching bottle labeled 'HYPER' are visible on a wooden tray. (3) The scene cuts back to the two men; the man in the green shirt is now leaning in closer, placing his hand on the other man's shoulder. His expression is exaggeratedly seductive. (4) An extreme close-up shows a thick, brown caramel sauce being drizzled slowly over a chocolate-covered cake roll sprinkled with nuts. The texture of the sauce is glossy and viscous. (5) A hand is seen squeezing a fresh orange slice into a red-colored drink filled with fruit and mint leaves. The scene then shows a person stroking the chin of the man in the cap, who looks slightly dazed. (6) The camera focuses on five different bottles and boxes of 'HARU' flavored lubricants arranged on a wooden table. The packaging is colorful and vibrant. (7) In the final phase, the man in the cap is holding a red box and talking on a smartphone, smiling playfully, while the man in the green shirt claps his hands in the background, looking up toward the ceiling.
